name: Plastic 4 Containers Spice Box - Multicolor
description:
Product Type: Masala / Spice Box

Material: Food-grade, unbreakable, odorless plastic (BPA-free)

Color: Multicolor

Dishwasher Safe: Easy to use and clean

Features: Airtight containers to keep spices fresh

Dimensions: 22.5 × 19.5 × 4 cm

Quantity: 1 pc

Description:
Keep your spices organized and fresh with this 4-container multicolor spice box. Made from durable, food-grade plastic, it is BPA-free, odorless, and easy to clean. The airtight design ensures your spices stay flavorful for longer, making it a practical and colorful addition to any kitchen.
